purpose: ALO Music P3 isolated Windows backend verification, no Qt

authenticode.signer_subject: CN=Python Software Foundation, O=Python Software Foundation, L=Beaverton, S=Oregon, C=US
authenticode.linux_result: Certificate identity extracted statically only; no Windows trust or Authenticode validation claimed.

controlled_pth.scope: Only this new application-private runtime; ignore environment and registry paths; -I -B on every Python invocation.

installation.pip_mode: Run pinned pip wheel via explicit zipimport under -I, install offline into private Lib/site-packages with --target, --no-index, --no-deps, --only-binary=:all:, --no-cache-dir, --no-compile. No ensurepip, get-pip.py, installer or system changes.
installation.pip_support_limitation: General pip management of an embeddable distribution is not officially supported; this is controlled vendoring for this one application test.

limitations.python_patch: 3.11.9 is the final PSF 3.11 Windows binary release, not the newest security release. Later 3.11 releases are source-only and contain security fixes not present in 3.11.9. This private environment is only for the bounded synthetic compatibility test; no claim of current security patch level.
limitations.windows_signature_validation: Mandatory before execution on user Windows. Any failure yields STOP and a results ZIP; no DLL or antivirus policy changes.
limitations.ucrt: Requires existing system ucrtbase.dll; no Windows or CRT installation is attempted.

primary_sources.fact: Official PSF Windows embeddable x64 artifact and release MD5.
3.11.9 was the last full bugfix release with binary installers; later security releases are source-only through October 2027.
App-private minimal embed distribution; pip omitted, ordinary pip management unsupported; controlled vendoring recommended.
._pth replaces search paths, ignores environment and registry, enables isolation; import site must be explicit.
pip25.3 official PyPI wheel, Python>=3.9, SHA256 and trusted publishing metadata.
